entry.title: Measures of Central Tendency and Their Importance in Data Science
entry.summary: In any data analysis or statistical endeavour, understanding the behaviour of a dataset is fundamental. One of the primary ways to summarise and interpret data is through measures of central tendency, which identify the central or typical value around which data points cluster. The three main measures of central tendency are mean, median, and mode. The mean, commonly known as the average, is calculated by summing all values in a dataset and dividing by the number of values. For example, if data represents the ages of participants in a survey, the mean gives the general age around which most participants’ ages are spread.
